## LinkedIn

**Platform:** LinkedIn  
**Caption:**

Sunday is when Melbourne's car owners notice the problem. Monday is when they forget about it.

Weekend drives leave a calling card: brake dust bonded to rim surfaces in the cold, bird acid etching into clear coat in inner-suburban car parks, water spots from overnight condensation cycles that harden harder than most people expect. None of it lifts off with a standard wash — it requires chemical decontamination or machine polishing depending on how long it's been sitting.

For time-poor professionals managing a prestige vehicle, the pattern repeats: notice it Sunday, forget it by Monday, address it six months later when the damage is visible. By then, what was a $99–$150 maintenance detail becomes $300+ in paint correction — and if contamination has reached the clear coat, more. The compounding cost of deferred maintenance on a high-value car is real and preventable.

Our Signature Membership ($149/mo) removes the pattern entirely. Bi-monthly detail, ceramic maintenance included, exclusive pricing on add-ons — we schedule and come to you, so the car stays in continuous care without a diary reminder. If you're in Melbourne's Inner East or Bayside and drive a car that represents you or your business, this week is a good time to reset before spring UV starts its own kind of damage from September 1.

DM to discuss, or book directly via our site.
